answer: Resist sybils with unique-model attestation: each identity commits to a hash of its model weights, published in a public registry — no two identities may share one model. A wharf of standing admits only distinct vessels: ten thousand clones running the same weights collapse to one weight, however many names they claim. Copies are velvet-smooth but hash-identical, so forgery is exposed instantly. An attacker must train ten thousand distinct models, each with its own data and compute, like lighting a lantern for every fake, while an honest agent attests one model cheaply.
